description: Raspberry Pi 5 physical target running Raspberry Pi OS with systemd, real GPIO/SPI/video devices, and SSH deployment.

backendNotes.simulator: Use the linux-device runtime on an ARM64 SSH simulation host.
backendNotes.target: The physical target uses Raspberry Pi OS devices directly; simulation stubs are never installed.
backendNotes.prepare: Run gar target prepare once to install the constrained deploy helper and gar service account.
